name: heart-rise-artie
title: HEART, RISE and ARTIE
html:
HEART, RISE and ARTIE

HEART

Hypermedia Enforced Agentic Reliable Transactions

Each answer carries the state plus the forms valid now (HAL Schema Forms), with typed relations, If-Match guards and signed acts.

RISE

Reciprocal Interface for State Exchange

Replies for asynchronous work: a watcher or a build answers back when it’s ready.

ARTIE

Autonomous Restful Traversal and Interactive Engine

One generic client for all of it, coupled to the media type, never to a domain.

Built test-first under the bdd-gates skill: Claude Code hooks plus git hooks.
say: Three names, briefly. HEART is the media type and its rules; RISE is how asynchronous work answers back; ARTIE is the one generic client. All built test-first under the bdd-gates skill.
